shortDescription: NuScale Power NYSE:SMR plunged 13.2% in Friday's trading as UBS downgraded shares to Sell from Neutral with a $6 price target, slashed from $10, saying the company's path to secure firm customer orders orders is increasingly difficult as peers make tangible commercial progress with competing design…

children: plunged 13.2% in Friday's trading as UBS downgraded shares to Sell from Neutral with a $6 price target, slashed from $10, saying the company's path to secure firm customer orders orders is increasingly difficult as peers make tangible commercial progress with competing designs.

UBS analyst Jon Windham expects only 2-4 advanced small modular reactor designs to scale tomeet demand for commercial electricity generation, but with competitor projects already at or near construction and NuScale's
estimated five-year lead time for plant construction and lack of firm customer commitments, he believes the company's path forward is increasingly difficult.
Windham said he now assumes only one NuScale

project begins construction in 2028 and forecasts ~$700M of cumulative 2026-28 cash burn, while revenue rises from an estimated $185M in 2028 to $924M in 2030 but earnings remain negative through 2030.
The analyst forecasts just $29M of 2028 EBITDA at current prices, while the market implies $124M, but project delays, RoPower setbacks, and limited TVA progress should expose this gap.

title: NuScale Power plunges as UBS cuts to Sell, 'a first mover no more'
